en.headline: Shek Kip Mei art village hangs 100 hand-painted Mid-Autumn lanterns
en.dek: JCCAC's courtyard display runs until 27 September, lighting up from 6pm, with lantern riddles and a retro photo set on the second-floor terrace.
body: The Jockey Club Creative Arts Centre in Shek Kip Mei is showing more than 100 hand-painted lanterns in its central courtyard through 27 September, as part of a Mid-Autumn programme the venue calls Retro Mid-Autumn Night.

The centre said students and resident artists painted the lanterns, including work by more than 60 pupils who were asked to draw on memories of older Hong Kong. The courtyard is open daily from 10am to 10pm, with the lanterns lit from 6pm. Traditional lantern riddles are set out for visitors. Admission to the display is free. The centre is at 30 Pak Tin Street.

A vintage-bar photo set by the studio Kam Hei Light and Shadow occupies the second-floor terrace for the same dates. Separate paid or booked workshops ran on Saturday; a guided look at the studio's collected objects is listed for the afternoon of 27 September.
The Leisure and Cultural Services Department separately continues its larger Mid-Autumn lantern carnival at Victoria Park until 27 September, with lights from 6:30pm to 11pm.

zh.headline: 石硜尾藝術村掛起百盎手繪中秋燈籠
zh.dek: 賽馬會創意藝術中心庭園展出至9月27日，每晚6時亮燈，並設燈謎及二樓懷舊酒吧佈景，免費參觀。
body: 位於石硜尾的賽馬會創意藝術中心正於中央庭園展出逾100盎手繪燈籠，作為「懷舊中秋夜．藝術村綵燈展」一部分，展期至9月27日。
中心表示，燈籠由學生及駐村藝術家繪製，當中包括六十多名學生以舊香港印象入題的作品。庭園每日上午10時至晚上10時開放，燈籠由晚上6時起亮燈，現場設傳統燈謎。綵燈展免費入場。場地在白田街30號。
同期二樓平台由金回光影設置「懷舊酒吧」佈景供拍照。周六已舉辦工作坊；中心亦列出9月27日下午的藏品導賞。
康樂及文化事務署在維多利亞公園的中秋綵燈會同期舉行至9月27日，亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時。
